Both Assistant A and Assistant B misunderstood the third statement. The third statement does not say that bananas cost less than oranges; it says that bananas cost more than apples and more than oranges. The correct evaluation of the third statement should be:

[The Start of Corrected Reference Answer]
true.
[The End of Corrected Reference Answer]
